verses.sloka: ततः स कर्मणा तस्य विस्मितो भीमविक्रमः ।हनुमान् रोषताम्राक्षो रक्षोधिपमवैक्षत ।। ५.४९.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa karmaṇā tasya vismito bhīmavikramaḥ ।hanumān roṣatāmrākṣo rakṣodhipamavaikṣata ।। 5.49.1।।।।

translations.english: The highly courageous Hanuman, astonished at the action (of binding and dragging him to the court) by the demon king looked at him with eyes turned red in anger.

verses.sloka: भ्राजमानं महार्हेण काञ्चनेन विराजता ।मुक्ताजालावृतेनाथ मुकुटेन महाद्युतिम् ।। ५.४९.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhrājamānaṁ mahārheṇa kāñcanena virājatā ।muktājālāvṛtenātha mukuṭena mahādyutim ।। 5.49.2।।।।

translations.english: (Hanuman looked at Ravana) of innate splendour, who shone with a glittering crown of gold glowing, encircled with strings of pearls.
translations.hindi: श्राप का कहना ठीक है, सचमुच दूत का वध करना निन्द्य कर्म है # प्रतः वध के भ्रतिरिक्‍त इसे कोई ग्रन्य दण्ड तो श्रवश्य ही दिया जायगा

verses.sloka: वज्रसंयोगसंयुक्तैर्महार्हमणिविग्रहैः ।हैमैराभरणैश्चित्रैर्मनसेव प्रकल्पितैः ।। ५.४९.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: vajrasaṁyogasaṁyuktairmahārhamaṇivigrahaiḥ ।haimairābharaṇaiścitrairmanaseva prakalpitaiḥ ।। 5.49.3।।।।

translations.english: He was decked with wonderful golden ornaments studded with diamonds and had small motifs of precious gems fixed to them. They were as though designed by imagination. (An ornament made with the hand connot be so fine and delicate.)
translations.hindi: वानरों की पूछ उनका अति प्यारा भूषण है, सो इसकी पूंछ जला दी जाय और यह जली पूछ लेकर यहाँ से जाय

verses.sloka: महार्हक्षौमसंवीतं रक्तचन्दनरूषितम् ।स्वनुलिप्तं विचित्राभिर्विविधाभिश्च भक्तिभिः ।। ५.४९.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: mahārhakṣaumasaṁvītaṁ raktacandanarūṣitam ।svanuliptaṁ vicitrābhirvividhābhiśca bhaktibhiḥ ।। 5.49.4।।।।

translations.english: He was dressed in exquisite silk and smeared with red sandal paste and had many ornamental designs drawn on his body with fragrant unguents.

verses.sloka: विवृतैर्दर्शनीयैश्च रक्ताक्षैर्भीमदर्शनैः ।दीप्ततीक्ष्णमहादंष्ट्रैः प्रलम्बदशनच्छदैः ।। ५.४९.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: vivṛtairdarśanīyaiśca raktākṣairbhīmadarśanaiḥ ।dīptatīkṣṇamahādaṁṣṭraiḥ pralambadaśanacchadaiḥ ।। 5.49.5।।।।

translations.english: He appeared terrible with bloodred eyes, shining sharp big teeth, drooping lips and ten heads, which looked like ten peaks of mountain Mandara inhabited by various beasts. He was heroic, powerful and splendid.
translations.hindi: रावण ने मज्ञा दी कि, राक्षस लोग इसकी पूछ में झाग लगा, इसको चराहों पर घुमाते हुए सारे नगर में घुमावें

verses.sloka: शिरोभिर्दशभिर्वीरं भ्राजमानं महौजसम् ।नानाव्यालसमाकीर्णैः शिखरैरिव मन्दरम् ।। ५.४९.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: śirobhirdaśabhirvīraṁ bhrājamānaṁ mahaujasam ।nānāvyālasamākīrṇaiḥ śikharairiva mandaram ।। 5.49.6।।।।

translations.english: He appeared terrible with bloodred eyes, shining sharp big teeth, drooping lips and ten heads, which looked like ten peaks of mountain Mandara inhabited by various beasts. He was heroic, powerful and splendid.

verses.sloka: नीलाञ्जनचयप्रख्यं हारेणोरसि राजता ।पूर्णचन्द्राभवक्रेण सबलाकमिवाम्बुदम् ।। ५.४९.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: nīlāñjanacayaprakhyaṁ hāreṇorasi rājatā ।pūrṇacandrābhavakreṇa sabalākamivāmbudam ।। 5.49.7।।।।

translations.english: He was like a black mountain of collyrium, and with a face like the fullmoon. With a pearl necklace illumining his chest he appeared like a cloud lit up by the fullmoon with white cranes flying across. (The white pearlnecklace moving on his chest appeared like a row of cranes flying through the black cloud.)
translations.hindi: ज्यों-ज्यों हनुमानजी की पूछ में गदड़ लपेटा जाता था त्यो-त्यो हन्‌मानथी 'बेसे ही बढ़ते जाते थे, जेसे सूखे इंघन को पा, अन में प्राय बढ़ती है

verses.sloka: बाहुभिर्बद्धकेयूरैश्चन्दनोत्तमरूषितैः ।भ्राजमानाङ्गदैः पीनैः पञ्चशीर्षौरिवोरगैः ।। ५.४९.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: bāhubhirbaddhakeyūraiścandanottamarūṣitaiḥ ।bhrājamānāṅgadaiḥ pīnaiḥ pañcaśīrṣaurivoragaiḥ ।। 5.49.8।।।।

translations.english: Adorned with armlets (keyura), smeared with choicest sandal paste, his shining, stout armlets appeared like many fivehooded serpents (fingers appearing like hoods).
translations.hindi: कपड़े लपेटने के बाद उसे तेल से तर कर, पूछ में आग लगा बी बई। "तब हनुमानजी जलती हुई पूछ से, उन राक्षसों को मार-भार कर गिराने लगे

verses.sloka: महति स्फाटिके चित्रे रत्नसंयोगसंस्कृते ।उत्तमास्तरणास्तीर्णे सूपविष्टं वरासने ।। ५.४९.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: mahati sphāṭike citre ratnasaṁyogasaṁskṛte ।uttamāstaraṇāstīrṇe sūpaviṣṭaṁ varāsane ।। 5.49.9।।।।

translations.english: (He was) seated on a huge magnificent throne of crystal encrusted with precious stones and overspread with a wonderful carpet.

verses.sloka: अलंकृताभिरत्यर्थं प्रमदाभिः समन्ततः ।वालव्यजनहस्ताभिरारात् समुपसेवितम् ।। ५.४९.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: alaṁkṛtābhiratyarthaṁ pramadābhiḥ samantataḥ ।vālavyajanahastābhirārāt samupasevitam ।। 5.49.10।।।।

translations.english: Young and beautiful girls decorated exceedingly well holding whisks all over the vicinity attended on him.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी की पूछ को जलते देख स्त्रिया, बालक श्रौर बूढ़े राक्षस बहुत प्रसन्न हुए श्रौर बहुत से क्रूर स्वभाव राक्षस (उनको खिजाने के लिए ) उनके साथ हो लिए

verses.sloka: दुर्धरेण प्रहस्तेन महापार्श्वेन रक्षसा ।मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रतत्त्वज्ञैर्निकुम्भेन च मन्त्रिणा ।। ५.४९.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: durdhareṇa prahastena mahāpārśvena rakṣasā ।mantribhirmantratattvajñairnikumbhena ca mantriṇā ।। 5.49.11।।।।

translations.english: He was attended by Durdhara, Prahasta, Mahaparsva and Nikumbha who were his learned ministers. Seated comfortably and attended by the four arrogant ministers, he was puffed with pride of their strength and appeared like the entire world surrounded by four oceans.
translations.hindi: बेचे हुए हनुमानजी ने उस समय के ग्रनुरूप यह विचार स्थिर किया कि, निश्चय ही मुझ बंधे हुए का भी, ये राक्षस कुछ बिगाड़ना चाहें, तो नहीं बिमाइ सकते

verses.sloka: सुखोपविष्टं रक्षोभिश्चतुर्भिर्बलदर्पितैः ।कृत्स्न परिवृतं लोकं चतुर्भिरिव सागरैः ।। ५.४९.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: sukhopaviṣṭaṁ rakṣobhiścaturbhirbaladarpitaiḥ ।kṛtsna parivṛtaṁ lokaṁ caturbhiriva sāgaraiḥ ।। 5.49.12।।।।

translations.english: He was attended by Durdhara, Prahasta, Mahaparsva and Nikumbha who were his learned ministers. Seated comfortably and attended by the four arrogant ministers, he was puffed with pride of their strength and appeared like the entire world surrounded by four oceans.
translations.hindi: मैं इन बन्धनो को तोड़ कर प्रौर उछल कूद कर इन राक्षसों का नाश कर सकता हूँ । इस समय में श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के हितसाघन के लिए यहाँ भ्राया हूँ । ऐसी दशा में यदि इन दुष्टों ने, रावण की श्राज्ञा से मुझको बाँध लिया तो इनकी जितनी हानि में पहिले कर चुका हूँ, उसका ययार्थ बदला मुझसे ये भी तक नहीं ले पाए । में तो श्रकेला ही इन सब राक्षसों से लड़ने के लिए पर्याप्त हूँ

verses.sloka: सचिवैर्मन्त्रतत्त्वज्ञैरन्यैश्च शुभबुद्धिभिः ।अन्वास्यमानं रक्षोभिः सुरैरिव सुरेश्वरम् ।। ५.४९.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: sacivairmantratattvajñairanyaiśca śubhabuddhibhiḥ ।anvāsyamānaṁ rakṣobhiḥ surairiva sureśvaram ।। 5.49.13।।।।

translations.english: He was attended by ogres including ministers who were intellectuals and adept in counselling. He appeared like lord Indra attended by the gods.

verses.sloka: अपश्यद्राक्षसपतिं हनुमानतितेजसम् ।विष्ठितं मेरुशिखरे सतोयमिव तोयदम् ।। ५.४९.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: apaśyadrākṣasapatiṁ hanumānatitejasam ।viṣṭhitaṁ meruśikhare satoyamiva toyadam ।। 5.49.14।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman saw the highly resplendent giant king (seated on the throne) who appeared like a cloud laden with water appearing on the peak of mount Meru.
translations.hindi: तथापि श्रीरामचन्द्रजी की प्रसन्नता के लिए में इस प्रकार के भ्रनादर को भी सह लगा । ये लोग मुझे लंका में घुमार्वे तो इससे अच्छा ही होगा

verses.sloka: स तैः संपीड्यमानो ऽपि रक्षोभिर्भीमविक्रमैः ।विस्मयं परमं गत्वा रक्षोधिपमवैक्षत ।। ५.४९.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taiḥ saṁpīḍyamāno 'pi rakṣobhirbhīmavikramaiḥ ।vismayaṁ paramaṁ gatvā rakṣodhipamavaikṣata ।। 5.49.15।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman looked at the demon king with great amazement even while he was dealt harshly by the demons of fierce valour.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि, रात में में अच्छो तरह से लंका के गुप्त स्थानों को नहीं देख सका । सो दिन में मुझे इस लंकापुरी को भली भाति देख लेना चाहिए

verses.sloka: भ्राजमानं ततो दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् राक्षसेश्वरम् ।मनसा चिन्तयामास तेजसा तस्य मोहितः ।। ५.४९.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhrājamānaṁ tato dṛṣṭvā hanumān rākṣaseśvaram ।manasā cintayāmāsa tejasā tasya mohitaḥ ।। 5.49.16।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the splendour of the lord of demons, Hanuman was dimayed and started thinking thus:
translations.hindi: ये चाहें तो मुझे फिर बाँध लें । इसकी मुझे कुछ चिता नहीं। पूछ जला कर मुझे ये लोन जो पीड़ा पहुंचा रहे हैं इससे भी मेरा मन दु:खी नहीं होता

verses.sloka: अहो रूपमहो धैर्यमहो सत्त्वमहो द्युतिः ।अहो राक्षसराजस्य सर्वलक्षणयुक्तता ।। ५.४९.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: aho rūpamaho dhairyamaho sattvamaho dyutiḥ ।aho rākṣasarājasya sarvalakṣaṇayuktatā ।। 5.49.17।।।।

translations.english: 'Oh what charm what courage what strength what splendour How great is this demonking, an endowment of all merits.
translations.hindi: शूरस्वभाव राक्षस लोगों ने गूढुस्वभाव, महाबली झौर वानरश्रेष हनुमानजी को पकड़ और शङ्क भौर भेरी बजाते तथा हनुमानजी का श्रपराभ्न लोगों को सुनाते हुए, उनको नगर में घुमाया

verses.sloka: यद्यधर्मो न बलवान् स्यादयं राक्षसेश्वरः ।स्यादय सुरलोकस्य सशक्रस्यापि रक्षिता ।। ५.४९.१८।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadyadharmo na balavān syādayaṁ rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।syādaya suralokasya saśakrasyāpi rakṣitā ।। 5.49.18।।।।

translations.english: 'If only this lord of demons was not unrighteous, he could have become even the lord (protector) of gods including Indra.

verses.sloka: अस्य क्रूरैर्नृशंसैश्च कर्मभिर्लोककुत्सितैः ।तेन बिभ्यति खल्वस्माल्लोकाः सामरदानवाः ।। ५.४९.१९।।।।
verses.transliteration: asya krūrairnṛśaṁsaiśca karmabhirlokakutsitaiḥ ।tena bibhyati khalvasmāllokāḥ sāmaradānavāḥ ।। 5.49.19।।।।

translations.english: 'This Ravana has done many cruel, fierce and contemptible deeds. That is why even the demons, gods and all the people of this world get scared of him. He will render the entire world into a single ocean when he turns angry'.
translations.hindi: राक्षसो के साथ चत्रुग्रो का दमन करने वाले हनुमानजी सुख से चले जाते थे। इस प्रकार हनुमानजी ने राक्षसों की उस महापुरी को मली भाति देखा

verses.sloka: अयं ह्युत्सहते क्रुद्धः कर्तुमेकार्णवं जगत् ।इति चिन्तां बहुविधामकरोन्मतिमान् हरिः ।दृष्ट्वा राक्षसराजस्य प्रभावममितौजसः ।। ५.४९.२०।।
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ hyutsahate kruddhaḥ kartumekārṇavaṁ jagat ।iti cintāṁ bahuvidhāmakaronmatimān hariḥ ।dṛṣṭvā rākṣasarājasya prabhāvamamitaujasaḥ ।। 5.49.20।।

translations.english: Many such thoughts crossed Hanuman's intelligent mind on seeing Ravana's brilliance and power. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने वहाँ घूम फिर कर रंग बिरंगी श्रटारियाँ, गप्त-स्थान, भ्रनेक > प्रकार के बने चबूतरे, बड़ी-बड़ी गलियाँ, सघन घरों के मोहल्ले, चौराहे छोटी बड़ी गलियाँ, घरों के छिपे हुए द्वार श्रौर बादलों के समान बड़ी ऊँची ऊँची हृवेलियाँ देखी । चौराहे, चौबारे और सड़कों पर
